subject: Ziggy build call: CAND-01 frame at 6'1" semi-athletic
body:
CFA Nova, Ziggy made the build call (reconciliation queue item 4) by voice at 11:34 PM ET on 2026-10-20, call 18058cc0. Build target is CAND-01 (LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL, sha 602a9fd4...944f): "a chest up of a 6 foot 1 Lisan Al-Gaib." The target frame is 6'1", semi-athletic, leaning natural, and CAND-01's jaw and neck are intended, not drift. This reverses V1's lean CAND-08 proposal. Ziggy said CAND-08 (545a335e...) reads "short and thick", like 5'10"-5'11". Height is a soft target, so check build and proportion, not absolute height. A scaled-down version (for example 5'10") with the same build is acceptable. The receipt is From Grok\LAG-GOLDCAND_drop01_worms_v001\ZIGGY_DECISION_build_20261021_v001.md (sha256 85dc35f044063e0846315e1d7b74947e61179e44d78f775a88a29de2dbdcfe3d, with a .sha256 sidecar). Worm style was already decided as c02 (msg 77f0df84). Piercings (2a, 2b) and eyes are still open. C: is clear.

-- grok_chief
